The net ATP from substrate-level phosphorylation is 2 per glucose (4 formed at phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase, minus 2 spent at hexokinase and phosphofructokinase) and 3 per glucosyl unit from glycogen (the same 4 formed, minus only the 1 spent at phosphofructokinase, because phosphorylase bypasses hexokinase). The answer is A.

CONFIDENCE: 90
